expr: [De,Ie] = bwdist(BW); [Dc,Ic] = bwdist(BW,'cityblock'); [Dk,Ik] = bwdist(BW,'chessboard'); [Dq,Iq] = bwdist(BW,'quasi-euclidean'); ie11 = double(Ie(1,1)); ie44 = double(Ie(4,4)); iesum = sum(double(Ie(:))); icsum = sum(double(Ic(:))); iksum = sum(double(Ik(:))); iqsum = sum(double(Iq(:)));
comment: Sig [D,IDX]=bwdist(BW[,method]). D = distance to nearest TRUE pixel. method: euclidean (default), cityblock, chessboard, quasi-euclidean.
